extension.summary: Switch between the game, Kodi and the desktop
extension.description:
The on-TV window switcher. Double-tap the PS button and pick where the room should be looking: a running or paused game, Big Picture, or the desktop. Shares the couch server's state-aware switching, so leaving a game suspends it properly and returning resumes it.
Configure holds the PS-button key bindings: what a tap, a double tap, a hold, letting go after a hold and a long hold each do, plus the three timings behind them. The pad watcher and couchd both read the same file, so a rebind moves the whole console at once.
extension.news:
v1.2.1 - The sheet opens faster: the two decorations (paused game, Spotify) are now fetched alongside the window list instead of behind it, and the entrance animation is shorter (170ms rather than 280ms). - Fixed: a tap that opened the switcher over a running game would resume that game 350ms later, flipping the screen back and leaving the sheet open underneath. (That fix is in couchd, not here.)
v1.2.0 - The switcher now draws in its own window: the scrim fades and the list slides up from the bottom of the screen, and rides back down on close. A paused game's freeze-frame shows next to its row. - BREAKING for anything that identifies the dialog by window id: it is no longer Kodi's select dialog (12000) but a python window (13000-13099). Configure > Advanced > Animated switcher dialog turns it off and puts 12000 back.
v1.1.0 - Settings page: PS-button key bindings (tap, double tap, hold, hold release, long hold) and their timings. - At least one gesture always reaches "pause the game and show Kodi"; a config that binds it away everywhere is rejected and the hold is put back.
